title: AuditReportBase
description: Canonical $defs library for audit-report shapes. Provides the report skeleton (header + findings + counts) that any audit-style skill can extend. Skill-level audit reports add their own findings schema (referencing finding.base.json) and verdict-count breakdown.

severityCounts.description: Severity histogram over findings[]. Total equals len(findings).

auditMeta.description: Optional self-attested validation status. Consumers may treat missing fields as no-signal rather than as silent passes.

schema_validation_pass.description: True iff every finding in findings[] passed its schema validator.

rule_set_version.description: Version of the rule set used (e.g. 'CONTRACTS.md@1.0', 'prose_standards@1.0').
